ourKits.combo: Scar to apply Marked stacks, Obliterate missiles that prioritize the Marked target, consume stacks for a root, then Reckoning to pull one hero into the Nether Realm and steal their power.
ourKits.winCondition: Isolate a target with Reckoning and crit them down 1v1, taking extra bounty gold on the kill.
ourKits.passive: Bounty Hunter: physical power scales with crit chance and bonus attack speed, and hero kills give extra gold.
ourKits.playWith: A team that can fight the remaining four while he duels one target in the Nether Realm.
ourKits.playAgainst: Dodge the Scar orb, since it sets up the root and focuses Obliterate. Do not get caught alone when Reckoning is up; armor helps against his physical damage.

ourKits.combo: H11 Cluster Grenades and Land Mine to slow and stun, R2000 Missile charged for full damage, then Make It Rain on the held enemies.
ourKits.winCondition: Lock down space with grenades and mines and rain missiles on enemies stuck in them.
ourKits.passive: Armed Salvo empowers his next basic with area damage that restores mana, and each ability cast shortens its cooldown.
ourKits.playWith: CC and chokepoints that force enemies into his zones.
ourKits.playAgainst: Walk around grenades and get out of Land Mine's blast before it goes off. He can blast himself away with Land Mine, so engage after it is used; magical armor helps against his burst.

ourKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
ourKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
ourKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
enemyKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
enemyKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill to slow, Molotov to ignite the oil, Flame Turrets to keep shooting, then Inferno and its knockback belch.
enemyKits.winCondition: Layer oil, fire and turrets on a choke or objective and burn the team that has to stand in it.
enemyKits.passive: Badlands Critter basics stack Slick, a slow that lets his fire ignite the target.
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire and oil.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not fight in his oil and fire; flank around it. Melee basics break Flame Turrets quickly, and turrets go inactive when he moves away from them, so drag the fight off them; magical armor helps.

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
enemyKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
enemyKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
enemyKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
enemyKits.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
enemyKits.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

enemyKits.combo: Stampede to drag a target, Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, Warlord's Challenge to stun and steal power, then Double Pain to cleave and heal.
enemyKits.winCondition: Chain pull and stuns onto one target while Bloodlust bleed stacks and Warlord's Challenge attack speed shred them.
enemyKits.passive: Bloodlust makes basics stack a bleed for damage over time.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that can hit the target he drags and stuns.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stampede has a delay before the charge and Smash 'n Grab channels before the shockwave, so sidestep both. Fight after he spends them, and buy anti-heal against Double Pain's heal.

bullets: Endless Hunt reset Piercing Shot, Hail of Arrows and Heightened Senses on takedowns, so after a kill she could stealth again and keep firing.
Wind-Rider's attack speed after leaving stealth, plus Eviscerator's, meant more Weald missiles at heroes below 30% health; Forage just added gold and XP from farm.

Assault The Gates leapt him in, Saphir's Mantle grew his health and hit nearby heroes, and Forticus shielded him as damage landed, so diving cost him little.
Nihil's Doom grew power and armor as he stayed on heroes after Assault The Gates; From the Abyss healed each second and Adaptive Plating added armor per hit.
Imperial Soul widened Stone Forged Soul, which healed him in stasis and then crashed down, while Fire Blossom and Tainted Guard punished anyone who stayed close.
Unleash's fast attacks each triggered Overlord's splash and Sky Splitter's current-health damage at 65% strength, and Unleash cleaves too, so each flurry hurt enemies around his target.
Knell's Rust shredded armor and handed him 75% of it, Peal made hits after Cull apply full Rust, and Frequency gave attack speed and haste per stack.
Draconum stacked extra healing as he hit heroes, so Judgement's heal and Invigorate restored more, while Forticus shielded him whenever heroes hit back.
